meaning: Denied, failed, or remove an item such as a chip or file
notes: Deliberately close to close: dismiss is the status mark that pairs with checkmark (denied, failed) and removes a chip or file, so it is drawn a step smaller (10.5 across) than close (13 across), which closes a surface.
